summary.text: Customers find the headphones to be of good quality with superb sound and long-lasting battery life. The connectivity receives mixed feedback - while some praise the fast Bluetooth connection, others report frequent disconnections. Comfort and durability are also mixed aspects, with some finding them comfortable in the ears while others report ear pain, and some units breaking within a month of use. Reliability is a concern as units stop working properly, and opinions on value for money are divided between those who find it worth the price and those who consider it a waste of money.

authors_reviews.title: Decent Build and Sound, but No Auto Magnetic Connect/Disconnect
authors_reviews.text: I purchased the boAt Rockerz 250 Pro+ and, considering the price, it offers good value for money. The sound quality is impressive, with clear audio and decent bass, making it suitable for daily music listening and calls. The build quality also feels good and durable.However, there are a few drawbacks. The magnetic earbuds do not automatically power off or disconnect when attached together. Instead, I have to manually long-press the button to disconnect and switch off the neckband. Similarly, when separating the magnetic earbuds, they do not automatically reconnect; I need to long-press the button again to connect the device.Another disappointment is the lack of Transparency Mode and Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) options. The product specifications and app experience can be confusing, but I could not find any option to enable Transparency Mode or ANC in the boAt app for the Rockerz 250 Pro+.Overall, the neckband delivers good sound quality and build quality for its price, but the missing auto magnetic connect/disconnect feature and the absence of Transparency Mode and ANC reduce the overall convenience.
authors_reviews.author: azher

authors_reviews.title: Good Battery Backup and Loud Sound, but Not Rainproof
authors_reviews.text: I have been using this neckband for regular daily use and overall the performance is good. The battery backup is quite good, so it is suitable for long listening sessions without needing frequent charging. The 12mm drivers produce loud and clear sound, and the music quality is good for this price range. The bass and overall audio output are satisfying for everyday music, videos and calls.Pros:Good battery backupLoud and clear soundBest connectivity and better backupGood music quality12mm driversComfortable for regular useBending the neckband during normal use does not cause any immediate problemCons:It is not suitable for heavy rain. During heavy rain or prolonged exposure to water, the neckband can get damaged quickly. So I would recommend avoiding use in heavy rain, even though it works well for normal daily use.Overall: A good neckband for daily music and long usage, especially considering its battery backup and loud sound. Just keep it away from heavy rain and excessive water exposure.
authors_reviews.author: Joshua Massey
